findings.message: Required section §10 Supporting Systems is missing. The SRS contract requires this section to be complete for L/XL complexity, or use explicit 'n/a' with a reason where permitted. Add §10 documenting supporting systems (CI/CD, monitoring, logging, deployment, etc.) or explicitly justify why these are out of scope.
findings.subject: SRS §10 Supporting Systems

findings.message: Required section §11 External Integration Landscape is missing. The SRS contract requires this section to exist; active external boundaries should have protocol/auth/SLA/contract information. Add §11 documenting external integrations (WebSocket client/server, any external services) or explicitly justify why no external integrations exist.
findings.subject: SRS §11 External Integration Landscape

findings.message: Security controls section should follow the structured contract approach: check security axes (OWASP Top 10, appropriate ASVS level, agentic-AI axes when applicable). While local execution may justify minimal security controls, the section should explicitly document this using the structured 'n/a' pattern rather than a casual 'no security concerns' statement.
findings.subject: SRS §6 Security Considerations
